'''Terrant''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials in a small shop.
